create_gaussian_privacy_engine: create a GaussianPrivacyEngine instance using PrivacyEngineFactory.create with a PrivacySetting and user counts
create_noise_type_enum: create a NoiseType enum value GAUSSIAN for use with PrivacyEngineFactory to select noise distribution
create_privacy_setting: create a PrivacySetting dataclass with noise_multiplier, clipping config, and target_delta for DP-SGD
create_clipping_setting: create a ClippingSetting dataclass with FLAT or ADAPTIVE clipping type and clipping_value for gradient clipping
create_privacy_budget: create a PrivacyBudget named tuple with epsilon, alpha, and delta values to track differential privacy spend
